title: Пакет депонування
fields_and_relations: Дозволений склад, source_revision_no і source_transfer_version, approval/ack.
required_interaction: Send/повтор/withdraw; старий upsert не відновлює доступ; пакет не експортує O46 та фізичний інвентар.

implementation.view_model: Frozen package, approval, local send/ack/reject/retry, monotonic withdrawals and delayed-upsert rejection
implementation.state_storage: Shared normalized browser store v9; additive v1–8 migration without resetting user work or revoked grants
permissions: Scoped text.read/write/review, consent.read/write, processing.run and deposit.manage are independent
Consent evidence is not exposed by text/public/deposit views
Processing and deposit require separate current use decisions
implementation.atomicity: Command validates scope, expected version, exact relationships and immutable hashes before one commit; forms hold drafts until confirmation
limitations: Local browser prototype; actual media playback, OCR/HTR/STT services and network transport are not connected.
Text parts use one line per utterance; derivation aligns equal line counts. Arbitrary many-to-many alignment, timed-layer editor and graphical music notation remain pending.
Human text review supports accept/reject/defer; correction is an explicit new content revision followed by review.
Consent create and partial/full withdrawal work. Separate replacement acts, broad multi-person policy authoring and rights renewal UI remain pending.

Deposits use an explicit title/summary whitelist and a restricted no-public-display snapshot. Receiving is an acknowledgement simulation; production entity_origin projection, receiver policy creation and independent receiving installation remain pending.
Demonstration processing records its real local tool name with no invented model or confidence; it does not perform recognition.
